thread:
liam: Heads up, finance flagged ~0.2% extra tokens on yesterday's invoices vs preview. dug into logs and saw a spike of repeated requests from our edge retries window. looks like retries are double-counting in the metering pipeline. anyone else see this? :eyes:
nina: yup saw similar in /var/logs/edge/errors. retries have new request_id per attempt so metering treats them as distinct. we intentionally borked idempotency for a short window when we switched proxy last month.
chelsea: oof. so billing consumer relies on `request_id` dedupe. if edge generates a fresh one each retry we lose dedupe. what's current retry behavior? exponential backoff x3?
tom: edge uses 3 retries for 5xx/connection errors with `X-Request-Id` reset each attempt by the client lib. clientlib should preserve Idempotency-Key but many SDKs don't set it.
liam: two angles: 1) enforce idempotency key from client SDKs (sdk PR incoming) 2) make metering more robust by using an idempotency fingerprint computed from stable fields (tenant + session + payload_hash) at ingest.
nina: computing fingerprint at ingest sounds good but we must keep it small and fast. suggest `fp = blake2b(payload_bytes, key=tenant_id)[:16]`. cheap and deterministic.
chelsea: careful: payload_hash for streaming/generative requests may change across retries because of KV-cache pointers. need canonicalization rules. maybe base on request metadata only: tenant + route + timestamp_bucket(1m) + prompt_hash?
tom: downside: timestamp_bucket could collapse distinct user retries into same fp if they legitimately reissued different prompts quickly. false dedupe risk.
liam: tradeoff. we can implement a soft-dedupe at aggregator: if duplicate fp arrives within 2s, mark as likely retry and drop, but otherwise keep. that keeps window tiny and reduces false positives.
chelsea: must reflect on quotas too. dropping duplicate event in billing should not affect immediate quota enforcement at edge. edge still consumes quota on first attempt. if aggregator drops duplicates, invoices align, but console quota meters might show transient overshoot.
nina: propose flow: - edge: encourage SDKs to emit `Idempotency-Key` header (uuid) - edge: if header missing, compute local `idempotency_fp` and pass downstream - ingest: attach `ingest_fp` (sha256 short) and store event->fp mapping for 24h - aggregator: de-duplicate using `ingest_fp` within 3s soft window - billing: primary joins on `ingest_fp`; fallback on request_id for older events
tom: sounds reasonable. what about historical backfill? finance wants reconciled numbers for last 30 days. can't retroactively compute ingest_fp for things we didn't store.
liam: backfill plan: reprocess raw proxy logs to derive fp where possible but only for events with full payload available. estimate ~70% recoverable. finance can apply a correction factor for remaining 30%.
chelsea: dashboard changes: add a panel for "retry-dedup-rate", "duplicate-token-drops", and a histogram of inter-arrival times for same fp. also an alert: if dedupe drops >0.5% of tokens in 5m, page eng-sre.
nina: storage costs: storing fp mapping for 24h at 200M events/day ~ 4GB/day if we store 40 bytes per row. TTL 24h seems fine. can compress further.
tom: implementation notes: aggregator dedupe should use a fast in-memory LRU with persistence to Kafka tombstones for consumer restarts. prefer Redis streams? meh, let's keep simple: local LRU + commit to dedupe topic.
liam: legal/privacy: ensure fp is irreversible. use keyed hash with rotating key and no raw payload retention. record key rotation schedule in spec.
chelsea: can we prototype in eu-canary? deploy small changes to edge logging + aggregator dedupe there. deploy-bot can schedule.
deploy-bot: canary deploy queued: edge-idempotency-shadow -> eu-canary at 2026-03-22T08:00:00Z.
liam: ok action items: nina -> SDK guidance PR and sample code snippet for `Idempotency-Key: uuid4()`; tom -> aggregator prototype with 3s soft-window dedupe; chelsea -> dashboard panels + alert rule; i'll coordinate finance backfill scope.
chelsea: i'll also draft a short note for Product so they know transient quota reads may show small drops during rollout.
tom: will add unit tests verifying no double-count for retries in integration harness.
liam: nice. thanks all. small change but should fix invoice noise. :thumbsup:
